attributes.action: Protect the Public: Reform the Prison System to Reduce Reoffending
attributes.additional_details: Prisons are overcrowded and reoffending remains high. We want Government to prioritise public safety by managing offenders according to risk. High-risk offenders should have secure specialist management, while suitable lower-risk offenders should receive rehabilitation, education, treatment and employment support. Persistent reoffenders should face stronger consequences. We want evidence-based reform that reduces reoffending, protects the public and saves taxpayers’ money.
attributes.background: We want the Government to reform prisons and probation to prioritise public safety and reduce reoffending, including secure facilities for high-risk offenders, rehabilitation and employment programmes for lower-risk offenders, and stronger consequences for persistent reoffending.

rejection.details: Some of what you are referring to already happens in prisons, in terms of risk ratings and related activities/support.  We are not clear exactly what you are calling for which is new and not already policy or practice.
